description.value: Set against the dark and rugged moorlands of northern England, WUTHERING HEIGHTS introduces two of the most startling characters in all literature: Heathcliff, an unfathomable mixture of savagery and gentleness; and Catherine, the woman he loved but drove to madness. This classic, unforgettable novel has truly been called "the strangest love story ever told." --back cover
